items.excerpt: Spotify rolled out three AI-driven audiobook features: Prompted Playlist lets listeners describe a mood or theme to generate a custom audiobook playlist, and a new conversational 'Just Ask Spotify' voice/text mode answers questions about a book or recommends what to listen to next.

Laura Harvey and Chris Reid distill a year of writing about scholarly publishing's 'second digital transformation,' pointing to how news and content businesses are increasingly restructuring around AI licensing deals with the likes of Meta, following moves by NewsCorp and Le Monde.

Writer Beware co-founder Victoria Strauss explains how AI has fueled a 'tsunami' of publishing scam solicitations and impersonations, making mass, personalized deception cheap enough that authors now need new habits to vet unsolicited offers.
